answer.text: Nominal risk-free rate + risk premium for bearing risk

explanation.text: The Logic: Source p.16 gives the required return formula as the nominal risk-free rate plus a risk premium. The required return incorporates the pure time value of money, expected inflation (built into the nominal risk-free rate), and a premium for risk borne by the investor. The Trap: Single-component definitions like only a risk-free rate, only a risk premium, or only inflation are inadequate per p.16. Note: Use the nominal risk-free rate so that inflation compensation is included alongside the risk premium.
